rules.description: An actor reference must resolve an actor definition whose actor_type and exact version match the reference.
A lifecycle predecessor artifact must resolve exact non-self snapshot bytes, identity, kind, schema, logical record, and an older semantic version.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga assumption evidence eligibility contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
An assumption assessment cannot establish itself or treat self-authored evidence as independent.
A synthetic-only Gate A assurance bundle must retain the exact synthetic-original license disposition and cannot claim verified retained permission.
A Gate A static assurance bundle cannot authorize deployment.
A Gate A assurance claim with only an evidence-gap binding must remain proposed and cannot be labeled supported.
An observed belief distribution must sum to one within the exact record-bound protocol tolerance.
The belief normalization binding must exactly equal every protocol-owned normalization policy field.
Belief probability rows must cover every declared state exactly once without duplicate or extraneous state identifiers.
The study analysis unit, split unit, protocol-owned synthetic analysis-unit-set reference, and complete ordered member universe must exact-bind the executable causal contract.
An identification query cannot be identified while a backdoor path remains open under its selected adjustment set.
The declared causal graph must be acyclic.
Every identification query must resolve one declared estimand and exact-bind its treatment and outcome nodes.
A complete back-door query must report identified if and only if its eligible adjustment set d-separates treatment and outcome; complete open paths must report not_identified.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga causal prohibited adjustment contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga causal query role contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
Selected adjustment-set identifiers must exactly equal the distinct non-null adjustment sets bound by identification queries.
Every retained split manifest must be frozen before first outcome access.
Train, calibration, and test member IDs must exact-bind the registry-owned manifest rows, remain unique and pairwise disjoint, and have an exact union equal to the bound analysis-unit universe.
Train, calibration, and test manifests must exact-bind three distinct protocol-owned split identities in their declared roles.
Every stratification input must resolve a matching observed pre-treatment graph-node role, be available by its manifest freeze, and cannot be an outcome or post-treatment operand.
Each directed edge must respect the declared temporal order.
Each observed group coverage disposition must be derived from empirical coverage and the declared target.
Empirical conformal coverage must equal covered count divided by evaluated count, with zero or nonobserved denominators propagating explicit unknown.
Conformal group results must cover the declared group universe exactly without omission or addition.
A finite-sample conformal guarantee cannot be asserted when exchangeability is unmeasured.
The declared conformal target coverage must equal one minus alpha.
A document-local identifier must resolve exactly once in its explicitly owned collection and may not be inferred by naming convention.
Each estimand reference must exact-bind the protocol-owned estimand assigned to its application section by the scientific contract profile.
An explicit evidence gap must remain unavailable and non-supporting, retain no evidence references, and state a substantive reason.
The frozen decision information set must contain exact typed references to both the observation and the belief.
Observation, belief, and decision must bind the same exact object reference.
Belief holder, decision actor, and readiness subject must exact-bind one assessed human identity, type, and version.
Observation event, measurement, availability, belief freeze, decision information freeze, and decision time must respect the declared epistemic chronology.
Joint silent-miss marginals and intersection must derive from one disjoint common-opportunity contingency partition.
Every synthetic opportunity time must be observed inside the exact common clock and window, and ordered member rows must not move across that frozen interval.
The complete ordered opportunity identities and typed rows must exact-bind one artifact-bound protocol-owned synthetic manifest; it is static resolver evidence, not a real population.
Every opportunity row must exact-bind the common object, clock, window, reference operands, role-typed human and automation channels, and warning and fallback rules.
Observed joint-miss risk must equal joint misses divided by declared opportunities, and joint misses cannot exceed either marginal miss count.
A joint silent miss requires both channels to miss while warning is not issued and fallback is not activated; nonobserved row operands must propagate to the affected cell and summary.
A nonobserved common-opportunity operand must force nonidentifiable status and nonobserved derived summaries.
A record's created_at must equal the first lifecycle event time, and every appended lifecycle event must be strictly later while immutable successors preserve the original creation time.
Current lifecycle status must equal the terminal ordered lifecycle event and may not be changed without an appended event.
A lifecycle status requiring scientific evidence or experiment binding cannot be asserted from Gate A evidence gaps and unresolved scientific dependencies.
Observation validity must be valid exactly for an observed value and otherwise equal the value epistemic state.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga ood derivation contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
The nine disjoint reference-by-detector cells must exhaust the OOD population exactly once.
The selective OOD count and reference OOD count must reconcile over the same declared population.
Every policy distribution must cover the exact action space once and sum to one.
A horizon weight must be the product of all history-local step ratios through that horizon.
All-zero cumulative weights make Kish ESS undefined and must not retain an observed ESS or ordinary sufficiency disposition.
Horizon ESS must use cumulative trajectory weights, not per-step ratios or a trusted scalar.
ESS rows must cover every horizon index from zero through maximum_steps minus one exactly once.
Every estimator must bind the exact declared cumulative weight set and evaluated horizon.
Estimator selection must be frozen before first outcome access.

Every trajectory, history, and information-set identity must be unique, and each frozen information set must exact-bind the policy schema and the complete ordered prior-action history before outcome access.
Every history-action cell with positive target probability must have positive behavior support; the assessment cannot remain supported otherwise.
The logged behavior propensity must equal the probability assigned to the logged action in the full behavior distribution.

Every behavior and target distribution must exact-bind the artifact-bound protocol-owned synthetic policy table selected for its role and history; the table is static resolver evidence, not an executed policy.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga ope step horizon completeness contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
Each step ratio must equal target logged propensity divided by behavior logged propensity.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga ope terminal completeness contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.

The retained trajectory identities must exact-bind the complete ordered artifact-bound protocol-owned synthetic trajectory manifest; the manifest is static resolver evidence, not a real dataset population.
Every ESS horizon row must reconcile its normalization mode, denominator, and resulting weight sum with the declared construction.
Upper clipping requires each transformed cumulative weight to equal min(raw cumulative weight, threshold).
The observed aggregate must equal the declared normalized weighted construction from observed capability estimates.
Each required readiness dimension must have one unambiguous capability binding in this contract.
The application capability rows must exact-bind the protocol-owned synthetic capability manifest selected for this artifact; the manifest is static resolver evidence, not a real capability inventory.
An observed capability disposition must be derived from its declared operator, threshold, and estimate.
Observed readiness time must lie inside its ordered window and follow every observation, belief, and decision input available to the assessment.
Any required or positively weighted unresolved capability must appear in the unresolved set and force a nonobserved aggregate with unknown disposition.
A censoring event cannot support a recovered disposition.
A competing event must propagate the competing-event disposition rather than recovery.
Recovery, censoring, and competing-event policy identities and each synthetic event type-to-role classification must exact-bind the executable recovery contract.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga recovery event derivation contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.

The application recovery-event rows and completeness boundary must exact-bind the protocol-owned synthetic event manifest selected for this artifact; the manifest is static resolver evidence, not a real event log.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga recovery input unknown propagation contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
A complete observed window with no qualifying event must be right censored, bind an explicit absent event, and use close minus index elapsed time.
A qualifying recovery event must occur within the declared recovery window.
The offline validator must reject the exact ga reference kind contract violation exercised by its bound reason-specific fixtures.
A protocol-owned versioned reference must exactly match the resolved definition version.
A registry-owned scalar identifier must resolve exactly once to the required definition kind, version, and owning protocol release.
A schema reference must resolve the exact local schema identifier and version in the immutable repository snapshot.
Accepted error risk and coverage must be derived from the declared accepted and population counts.
Selective accepted, ambiguous, and every explicit non-observed count must partition the population exactly.
The root and nested design freezes must be identical, precede feature and outcome access, and bound every adjustment-set freeze.
Target tuning requires a non-none adaptation mode, an exact procedure binding, and truthful target-label disclosure.
Transfer coverage must reconcile exactly, and observed estimates or uncertainty operands require the registry-owned minimum observed count.
Transfer disposition must be unknown for unresolved operands and not_identified only for complete operands proving a non-applicable eligibility condition.
Transfer source and target results must exact-bind the distinct protocol-owned synthetic domain identities assigned to their roles.
An observed transfer gap must equal target estimate minus source estimate under the exact shared metric contract.
Source and target results must bind the exact same metric, estimator, population, outcome window, unit, direction, and version contract.
The transfer analysis contract must be frozen before any target-domain data access.
Each group's coverage states must reconcile to its sample count and total.
Worst-group disposition must be identified for a resolved nonempty eligible set, no_eligible_groups for a resolved empty eligible set, and unknown for any unresolved required operand.
Eligible group IDs must equal exactly the observed groups satisfying the executable minimum-information rule.
Group information disposition must be computed from all executable minimum-information thresholds.
All eligible groups tied at the observed extremum must be reported.
Unresolved group membership must not coexist with observed performance, eligibility, or a confident worst-group extremum.
